## Upstream changes 3.7 -> 3.8.0

**Verdict:** NEEDS ATTENTION — a migration guide is explicitly called out for this range and the Kubernetes Gateway API minimum version is being raised, which is a dependency-facing breaking change even though this template does not run that provider; the CLI/dashboard-facing config in this compose file is unaffected per the image diff.

### Breaking changes
- The release note itself flags this as a migration-relevant upgrade: **"Important: Please read the [migration guide](https://doc.traefik.io/traefik/v3.8/migrate/v3/#v380)."** The detailed content of that guide is not included in the text provided, so its specifics cannot be quoted here — only its existence and the fact that upstream considers v3.8.0 migration-worthy.
- **[k8s/gatewayapi]** "Consume TCPRoute through its v1 version and drop Gateway API v1.5.x support" (#13626) — breaking for Gateway API users only.
- **[k8s/gatewayapi]** "Bump Gateway API minimal version to v1.7.0 in v3.8.0 migration guide" (#14190) — raises the minimum Gateway API CRD version. Not applicable to this template: it runs the Docker provider (`--providers.docker=true`), not `kubernetesGateway`.
- **[acme]** "Disable recursive nss propagation by default for DNS challenge" (#13830) and "Do not require recursive nameservers propagation by default for the DNS-01 challenge" (#13710) — this template uses the TLS-ALPN challenge (`acme.tlschallenge=true`), not DNS-01, so this does not apply here.
- **[server]** Several CONNECT-method hardening changes ("Reject CONNECT requests regardless of HTTP version", "Reject CONNECT method before reaching the muxer", "Deny request with an opaque request target") — behavioural tightening of the HTTP server that could reject previously-accepted malformed/edge-case requests. No compose-level action, but worth knowing if an upstream app behind Traefik relies on CONNECT.
- **[middleware]** "Disable Zstd support in the gzhttp wrapper" (#13533) — if any router here negotiated zstd compression, it will stop. The compose file's only compress middleware (`compresstraefik`) uses the generic `compress=true` flag with no algorithm pinned, so this is a silent behaviour change in what encoding gets served, not a config break.

### Variables
none — no renamed, removed, or newly required variables in the compose file or `.env.example` as a result of this range.

### Data and dependencies
- The Gateway API minimum-version bump ("Bump Gateway API minimal version to v1.7.0") is a companion-dependency requirement raised by this range, but it only applies if the Kubernetes Gateway provider is in use. This template's compose file pins no Kubernetes/Gateway API component and uses `providers.docker` exclusively — so this does not trigger a DO NOT APPLY verdict, but is recorded here as a condition that would matter in a different deployment shape.
- No change to postgres, redis, or affine image requirements is mentioned in these notes — they are a Traefik-only release.

### Before applying
- Read the upstream migration guide at `https://doc.traefik.io/traefik/v3.8/migrate/v3/#v380` before pulling, since the note names it explicitly and its content was not supplied for this review.
- Confirm no router in your Traefik dynamic config (beyond this template's own labels) depends on zstd compression negotiation, given "Disable Zstd support in the gzhttp wrapper."
- Confirm nothing behind this Traefik instance expects HTTP CONNECT tunneling to pass through, given the CONNECT-rejection changes.
- No backup, manual migration command, or config edit is required for this compose file's own settings — the image configuration (user, entrypoint, command, ports, volumes, healthcheck, environment) is unchanged between 3.7 and 3.8.0 per the registry comparison.

### Notes read
- v3.8.0 (2026-11-23)
- v3.7.20 (2026-11-23) — baseline, the version currently deployed
- v3.8.0-rc.3, v3.8.0-rc.2 (pre-release notes folded into the 3.8.0 entry, read for completeness)
- v2.11.64, v3.7.19, v2.11.63 — unrelated legacy branches, not part of this upgrade path, not used for the verdict

## Upstream changes 3.7 -> 3.8.0

**Verdict:** NEEDS ATTENTION — a migration guide is explicitly called out for this range and the Kubernetes Gateway API minimum version is being raised, which is a dependency-facing breaking change even though this template does not run that provider; the CLI/dashboard-facing config in this compose file is unaffected per the image diff.

### Breaking changes
- The release note itself flags this as a migration-relevant upgrade: **"Important: Please read the [migration guide](https://doc.traefik.io/traefik/v3.8/migrate/v3/#v380)."** The detailed content of that guide is not included in the text provided, so its specifics cannot be quoted here — only its existence and the fact that upstream considers v3.8.0 migration-worthy.
- **[k8s/gatewayapi]** "Consume TCPRoute through its v1 version and drop Gateway API v1.5.x support" (#13626) — breaking for Gateway API users only.
- **[k8s/gatewayapi]** "Bump Gateway API minimal version to v1.7.0 in v3.8.0 migration guide" (#14190) — raises the minimum Gateway API CRD version. Not applicable to this template: it runs the Docker provider (`--providers.docker=true`), not `kubernetesGateway`.
- **[acme]** "Disable recursive nss propagation by default for DNS challenge" (#13830) and "Do not require recursive nameservers propagation by default for the DNS-01 challenge" (#13710) — this template uses the TLS-ALPN challenge (`acme.tlschallenge=true`), not DNS-01, so this does not apply here.
- **[server]** Several CONNECT-method hardening changes ("Reject CONNECT requests regardless of HTTP version", "Reject CONNECT method before reaching the muxer", "Deny request with an opaque request target") — behavioural tightening of the HTTP server that could reject previously-accepted malformed/edge-case requests. No compose-level action, but worth knowing if an upstream app behind Traefik relies on CONNECT.
- **[middleware]** "Disable Zstd support in the gzhttp wrapper" (#13533) — if any router here negotiated zstd compression, it will stop. The compose file's only compress middleware (`compresstraefik`) uses the generic `compress=true` flag with no algorithm pinned, so this is a silent behaviour change in what encoding gets served, not a config break.

### Variables
none — no renamed, removed, or newly required variables in the compose file or `.env.example` as a result of this range.

### Data and dependencies
- The Gateway API minimum-version bump ("Bump Gateway API minimal version to v1.7.0") is a companion-dependency requirement raised by this range, but it only applies if the Kubernetes Gateway provider is in use. This template's compose file pins no Kubernetes/Gateway API component and uses `providers.docker` exclusively — so this does not trigger a DO NOT APPLY verdict, but is recorded here as a condition that would matter in a different deployment shape.
- No change to postgres, redis, or affine image requirements is mentioned in these notes — they are a Traefik-only release.

### Before applying
- Read the upstream migration guide at `https://doc.traefik.io/traefik/v3.8/migrate/v3/#v380` before pulling, since the note names it explicitly and its content was not supplied for this review.
- Confirm no router in your Traefik dynamic config (beyond this template's own labels) depends on zstd compression negotiation, given "Disable Zstd support in the gzhttp wrapper."
- Confirm nothing behind this Traefik instance expects HTTP CONNECT tunneling to pass through, given the CONNECT-rejection changes.
- No backup, manual migration command, or config edit is required for this compose file's own settings — the image configuration (user, entrypoint, command, ports, volumes, healthcheck, environment) is unchanged between 3.7 and 3.8.0 per the registry comparison.
